methods.label: Paper preset
methods.description: Published daily setup: 40 candles of history, temperature 0.6, top-p 0.9, and 10 averaged paths. The paper used a 12-candle horizon; you can change it here.

methods.label: Validate on this asset
methods.description: Compare four settings on earlier windows, audit the winner on two later windows, and compare with repeating the last price. Slower; measures recent historical performance.

methods.label: Custom
methods.description: Control context, sampling, volume inputs, and reproducibility. Changing a random seed does not optimize accuracy.
